steps.note: Open the single-stage create screen specified by the scenario.
Ensure vendors can be added during event creation as required by the case.
Change the event type from the default to Auction.
Every successful create flow requires an event title.
Apply the first offered auction template; the exact forward/sell template name is not provided.
Add the specified product and enter the decimal requested quantity.
Set the requested delivery location in the first row.
Read the resulting quantity after entry to record whether 2.5 was kept, rounded, cleared, or marked invalid.
Add one available QA vendor to satisfy the publish prerequisite.
Commit the 30-minute schedule specified by the scenario.
Assert that publishing reached a real project page.
